item.title: Limit on International Student Athletic Scholarships introduced in state bill
item.description: A state lawmaker aims to cap sports scholarships for international students at 25 percent per athletic program. State Rep. Brian Lorenz, R-Powell, introduced House Bill 584 last November to keep state money in Ohio, he said. Its first committee meeting was on Feb. 4 and applies to public colleges and universities, according to its text. […]

item.description: Ohio State’s “Listen. Learn.
